title: BOS-1237 setup-script progress bars re-render in place — ten redraws of one download occupy one row, and the setup output above them survives

scenes.title: reach the setup pane with a create that streams a progress bar

steps.caption: Press [n] to start a new session
[enter] submits the create and the scripted setup stream starts
The first setup frame — an ordinary non-progress line, emitted BEFORE the bar sequence

scenes.title: the bar sequence collapses onto a single row — the BOS-1237 fix

steps.caption: The download's sixth redraw reaches the setup pane — unfixed, six bars would be stacked by now

expect.label: the setup pane is open and the bootstrap is still in flight
the bar is on screen mid-sequence, at 60%
THE FIX: exactly ONE row on the whole screen carries a percentage bar. Before BOS-1237 each redraw appended, so by this point the pane held several stacked bars and the count only grew.
THE FIX: the non-progress line that preceded the bars is still visible. The pane keeps only its last ten elements, so ten stacked bars used to evict it outright.

steps.caption: AC1/AC2: ten frames of one download occupy one row, and the real setup output above them survives. Asserted mid-sequence rather than at 100%, so the row count is measured while redraws are still arriving.

scenes.title: the same row advances to 100% rather than growing a new row

steps.caption: Nine redraws later the bar reports 100% — in place, on the row that showed 10%

expect.label: still exactly ONE percentage row after all ten redraws — the row was rewritten, not added to
and the preceding setup line is STILL on screen at the end of the sequence

steps.caption: AC1: the row advanced in place across all ten redraws. This is assertable only because the fixture emits a trailing non-progress frame after the bars — the settled frame navigates the wizard onward, so the final bar would otherwise have a ~0ms visible window.

waitFor.label: the settled frame ends the wizard and hands off to the session

steps.caption: The terminal SessionCreated frame settles the create, so the recording ends on its destination rather than mid-stream

expect.label: the session the wizard created, by the title typed into the form

steps.caption: Collapsing the bar changed only what the pane retains — the create itself still settles and navigates as before.
